title: Export tracing via OpenTelemetry (traces, logs, metrics)
description:
Mark (2026-11-13): move mimid's logging to OpenTelemetry. This follows mimid-bfzm, which gave mimid-server named events, structured fields, error source chains, per-request spans and optional JSON output, all on tracing.

Approach: keep tracing as the instrumentation API and add OTel as the export layer; don't rewrite call sites into OTel APIs. This is the logging rule 'keep the established facility; change exporters, not call sites'.
- Traces: tracing-opentelemetry turns the existing spans (http_request, protocol_request, peer_call and the handler spans) into OTel spans.
- Logs: opentelemetry-appender-tracing sends tracing events as OTel log records. Event names become the event name and the named fields become attributes, with error source chains preserved.
- Export: opentelemetry-otlp (gRPC or HTTP) to a collector.
- Metrics: OTel metrics as mimid's first metrics facility, which mimid-bfzm deliberately left out. Candidates: requests by endpoint and status, refusals by reason, fanout queue depth and retries, KeyPackage stock per user, peer call latency and errors by peer.
close_reason: 991e82c: OTLP/HTTP traces, logs and metrics behind [telemetry]; not deployed (the host has no collector).
